user_prompt: We need to orchestrate a comprehensive readiness validation for our upcoming product launch that coordinates material receipt verification, workforce capability assessment, and operational readiness evaluation. As part of this process, we also need to ensure we can track and validate all the materials coming in from our suppliers, including verifying their specifications against our master records. Additionally, we'll need to reconcile all incoming supplier billing documentation with our purchase commitments to ensure financial accuracy before we greenlight the launch. Please design a workflow that brings all these validation streams together into a single orchestrated process.

result_preview.shortDescription: Autonomously matches vendor invoices to POs and contracts, flags discrepancies for approval.
result_preview.description: This agent automatically reconciles incoming vendor invoices against purchase orders and master contracts using three-way matching logic. It validates line-item quantities, pricing, and terms; flags exceptions such as overbilling, duplicate invoices, or policy violations; and routes approved invoices for payment processing. This reduces manual touchpoints, accelerates cash flow, and minimizes payment disputes.

result_preview.description: Systematically validates supplier invoices by cross-referencing purchase orders and contractual terms using multi-point verification. Detects irregularities including billing overages, repeated submissions, and non-compliance issues; escalates flagged items to authorized personnel for determination. Streamlines payment authorization workflows, enhances vendor accountability, and mitigates procurement risk.
